threshold_audit.threshold_name: Overall Minimum Sample Size (10 real users)
threshold_audit.rationale: Intended as a small-sample sanity check before starting spec work.
threshold_audit.risk: False confidence from 10 non-representative survey responses; potential sampling bias.

threshold_audit.rationale: Requires simple majority in a 10-person sample.
threshold_audit.risk: Fails to measure problem severity or pain frequency (e.g., Daily vs Annually).

threshold_audit.rationale: Requires 40% conversion intent in a 10-person sample.
threshold_audit.risk: Confuses stated willingness to pay ('Would pay $29') with observed payment behavior (credit card authorization / current SaaS spend).

threshold_audit.rationale: Requires 50% trial interest in a 10-person sample.
threshold_audit.risk: Confuses hypothetical trial interest with actual CLI installation and retention.

evidence_weight_matrix.rationale: High survey inflation rate; free responses express optimism without financial risk.

evidence_weight_matrix.signal_type: Observed Payment Behavior ('Currently paying $30/mo for X tool')
evidence_weight_matrix.rationale: Demonstrates existing budget allocation and active market demand.

evidence_weight_matrix.signal_type: Stated Trial Intent ('I would try a CLI proxy')
evidence_weight_matrix.rationale: Low friction to say yes; does not guarantee CLI installation.

evidence_weight_matrix.signal_type: Observed Installation Behavior ('Ran CLI binary & reproduced setup')
evidence_weight_matrix.rationale: Demonstrates actual user friction tolerance and technical commitment.

bias_risks.description: All 10 responses collected from a single Reddit thread or Discord channel.
bias_risks.impact: Distorts sample diversity; captures single sub-community bias.
bias_risks.mitigation: Require responses across >= 2 independent channels (e.g., HN + Reddit + Direct Interview).

bias_risks.description: Single individual submitting multiple anonymous survey responses.
bias_risks.mitigation: Ingestion gate response_id uniqueness check & IP/header anomaly detection.

bias_risks.description: Treating 'I would pay $29' as equivalent to validated commercial demand.
bias_risks.impact: False GO decision leading to wasted MVP engineering effort.
bias_risks.mitigation: Differentiate STATED_INTENT from OBSERVED_BEHAVIOR in evidence weighting.

bias_risks.description: APE converting internal heuristic (10 users) into verified scientific market law.
bias_risks.mitigation: Label all internal threshold counts as PROVISIONAL_THRESHOLD.

recommendation_justification: The hardcoded '10 real users' threshold is an unvalidated provisional heuristic (PROVISIONAL_THRESHOLD), not an empirically proven market law. While 0 real responses MUST remain locked to VALIDATE_MORE, future decision logic should evaluate Evidence Diversity, Behavioral vs Stated intent, and Severe Negative Signals rather than relying strictly on raw response counts.

engineering_assessment.orion_042_step_validity: ORION-042 was a necessary technical stopping line to prevent continuous self-referential simulation loops. However, hardcoding '10 real users' as an absolute gate was an unverified heuristic step.
engineering_assessment.biggest_epistemic_risk: Sampling bias (e.g. 10 responses from single Reddit sub) and confusing stated survey optimism ('I would pay $29') with verified commercial transaction behavior.
engineering_assessment.assumption_to_fact_conversion_risk: APE risks mistaking its internal threshold heuristic (10 users, 5 H1, 4 H2) for verified scientific market facts. All internal thresholds MUST be tagged PROVISIONAL_THRESHOLD.
engineering_assessment.next_orion_step: Do NOT write more simulation code or invent new thresholds. Wait for human operators to gather first 5-10 real user responses, or initiate a human outreach phase.
